text:
lina_cs: Heads-up — MercuryLedger needs a short demo uplift next Wednesday. They want EU + APAC capacity and asked for an IP allowlist (static IP pool) instead of header pinning.
oscar_support: Got it. What QPS and exact windows?
lina_cs: Customer expects ~300 sustained, 450 peak for a 3h window: 2026-07-21 10:00-13:00 UTC. They'll provide CIDRs.
ae_ravi: This demo is tied to contract renewal; ops please prioritize and note procurement is pending.
faye_eng: Technical plan: add IP allowlist, route to eu-central-1 + ap-southeast-2, model pin to v2-small, and pre-warm KV cache 25m before start.
milo_oncall: Ops guardrails: canary at 5% for 12m (wet-run), autorevert at 48h by default. Alerting: p50 > 220ms OR 5xx rate >1% -> page oncall. Also set per-session token ceilings to mitigate DoS.
oscar_support: Draft override payload (CIDRs to be filled by AE):

POST /v1/overrides
{customer: "mercuryledger", regions: ["eu-central-1","ap-southeast-2"], allowlist: {type: "ip", cidrs: ["203.0.113.0/28","198.51.100.0/28"]}, rate_override: {qps: 450, burst: 800}, duration: "48h", autorevert: true}

oscar_support: Plan: push to staging canary (5%) -> validate -> promote to prod. Will set TTL on allowlist to 5d.
deploy-bot: change-request 3591234567: applying IP allowlist + route override to staging canary (5%).
deploy-bot: change-success 3591234585: staging canary healthy after 12m. No errors.
oscar_support: Promoting to prod; scheduling autorevert 48h out. Allowlist TTL 5d for post-demo troubleshooting.
deploy-bot: change-success 3591234610: prod override applied to eu-central-1 and ap-southeast-2. QA smoke passed.
lina_cs: Added runbook and renewal note to customer file; AE will paste CIDRs and confirm warmup prompts.
milo_oncall: Added rollback playbook and alert hooks: https://playbooks.internal/mercuryledger-demo.
oscar_support: Ticket CS-1761 created with rollout details and contact list.
lina_cs: I'll follow up with AE for CIDRs and close thread after demo outcome. :thumbsup:
